body:
# 🏦 Chemy MC

**Economy-driven Minecraft server where wealth is power.**

---

## 💰 The Concept

Start from nothing. Build your empire. Control the market.

Chemy MC is a **player-driven economy survival server** where every diamond, every crop, every trade matters. No admin shops. No pay-to-win. Just pure capitalism, strategy, and grind.

---

## ⚡ Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **💼 Jobs System** | Earn money by mining, farming, hunting, and more |
| **🏪 Player Shops** | Build your own shop and set your own prices |
| **📈 Dynamic Economy** | Supply & demand affects prices. Adapt or bankrupt. |
| **🏠 Towny** | Create towns, claim land, tax citizens |
| **⚔️ Balanced PvP** | Wealth doesn't buy power. Skill does. |
| **🤝 Player Trading** | Direct trade, auctions, and black market deals |

---

## 🎯 How to Play

1. **Join** — Spawn with basic tools and starting cash
2. **Work** — Pick a job and start earning
3. **Trade** — Sell to players, not NPCs
4. **Invest** — Buy low, sell high, control the market
5. **Expand** — Build towns, hire players, become a tycoon

---
